## Design Settings » Homepage » Select Content to Display » Custom Content
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000098739

## Custom Content
This article goes over the available settings to edit the Custom Content sections on the homepage of the website, there are a total of 10 Custom Content sections. This section is meant to be displayed on the homepage exclusively and it consists of a Froala editor. To learn more about the available settings on the Froala editor, navigate to the following link: Everything About Froala WYSIWYG Text Editor
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12140066190/original/GuXkxa_e4jHn7DHRi09yIkYS5sv9LH3WDA.png?1710259598 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12140066472/original/utJEalW8ob9eNLKqqWdjvj5Ea82l1k3Xwg.png?1710259821 | alt: ]

## Visual Guide of the Custom Content Settings
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12140066526/original/RNtZ6ulCPAp_Yco8e6EN8vKGUxSqaXbF7Q.png?1710259909 | alt: ]

## 1. Hide On Mobile?
This setting controls if this section will be displayed on mobile devices or not.
No
This will show the section on mobile devices.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12140067657/original/q82LDUyy8tMNfvBMwiZalqSboOK8VEKslQ.png?1710260837 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12140067891/original/xDBlpkwvRhKtrRaaPDEUrN_GlqDFuVDLTw.png?1710260993 | alt: ]
Yes
This will hide the section on mobile devices
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12140068011/original/CBGUH3PX1Tycml0GX9HipWW3AWZflW76Ow.png?1710261079 | alt: ]

## 2. FROALA Editor
The settings available for each Custom Content section is the FROALA editor, to learn more about the available settings navigate to the following link: Everything About Froala WYSIWYG Text Editor
